_comment: Answer overrides where the source key file is wrong (each verified by re-derivation + zoom-crop; 2908/2933 also book-solution-backed). Multi-keys Q2913 (A,D) and Q2925 (B,C,D) come from the answer-key file and are genuine 'which hold' items (verified) — NOT overridden.

2908.reason: key 'c' wrong: area bounded by y=sqrt x, x=2y+3, x-axis (first quadrant) = int_0^3 [(2y+3)-y^2] dy = 9 = option D (book solution gives 9)

2910.reason: key 'd' wrong: area bounded by y^2=4ax and its latus rectum = 8a^2/3 = option B (option D's 8a^(3/2)/3 has the wrong power of a; both coincide only at a=1)

2933.reason: key 'c' wrong: region {y^2>=2x, x^2+y^2<=4x, x>=0, y>=0} has area (quarter circle pi) - int_0^2 sqrt(2x) dx = pi - 8/3 = option B (JEE Main 2017; book solution gives pi-8/3)
